#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

const int INF = (int)1e8;

struct Node {
    Node *left, *right;
    int batchSetValue;
    bool dirty;
    int min;

    static Node* build(int l, int r) {
        Node* node = new Node();
        if (l != r) {
            int m = (l + r) >> 1;
            node->left = build(l, m);
            node->right = build(m + 1, r);
        }
        return node;
    }

    static void setValue(int f, int t, int l, int r, int val, Node* node) {
        if (f > r || t < l) return;
        if (f <= l && t >= r) {
            node->setValue(val);
            return;
        }
        node->pushDown();
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        setValue(f, t, l, m, val, node->left);
        setValue(f, t, m + 1, r, val, node->right);
        node->pushUp();
    }

    static int query(int f, int t, int l, int r, Node* node) {
        if (f > r || t < l) return INF;
        if (f <= l && r <= t) return node->min;
        node->pushDown();
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        return min(query(f, t, l, m, node->left), query(f, t, m + 1, r, node->right));
    }

    static void update(int i, int l, int r, int val, Node* node) {
        if (i > r || i < l) return;
        if (i <= l && i >= r) {
            node->min = min(node->min, val);
            return;
        }
        node->pushDown();
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        update(i, l, m, val, node->left);
        update(i, m + 1, r, val, node->right);
        node->pushUp();
    }

    static void toArray(int l, int r, vector<int>& data, Node* node) {
        if (l == r) {
            data[l] = node->min;
            return;
        }
        node->pushDown();
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        toArray(l, m, data, node->left);
        toArray(m + 1, r, data, node->right);
    }

    static void fromArray(int l, int r, const vector<int>& data, Node* node) {
        if (l == r) {
            node->min = data[l];
            return;
        }
        node->dirty = false;
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        fromArray(l, m, data, node->left);
        fromArray(m + 1, r, data, node->right);
        node->pushUp();
    }

    void pushUp() {
        min = min(left->min, right->min);
    }

    void setValue(int val) {
        min = val;
        batchSetValue = val;
        dirty = true;
    }

    void pushDown() {
        if (dirty) {
            left->setValue(batchSetValue);
            right->setValue(batchSetValue);
            dirty = false;
        }
    }
};
